corpus.acquisition_method: commit-pinned raw GitHub URLs (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/<commit>/<path>); no mirror, no mutable branch

labels.bounded_scope: Bounded evaluation over three Python 3.12.13 documentation files and 70 chunks; it does not represent all Python documentation.
labels.dense_mode: Deterministic hash embedding diagnostic — not semantic retrieval
labels.diagnostic_only: Generation is deterministic extraction, not an LLM; results are diagnostic, not production readiness.
labels.generation: Offline deterministic extractive evaluation — not an LLM result
labels.hybrid_mode: Hybrid diagnostic using BM25 plus deterministic non-semantic hash embeddings
labels.non_semantic: Dense mode uses deterministic non-semantic hash embeddings; scores encode token overlap only, not meaning.
labels.separate_from_synthetic: This report is a separate real-local evaluation and is never combined with the synthetic report.

limitations: Bounded evaluation over three Python 3.12.13 documentation files and 70 chunks; it does not represent all Python documentation.
Dense mode uses deterministic non-semantic hash embeddings; scores encode token overlap only, not meaning.
Generation is deterministic extractive/template output, not an LLM result.
Results are diagnostic, not production readiness; no quality claim is made.
No chunk-level or claim-level text is stored in this report; citations carry excerpt checksums and short prefixes only, and abstention details are truncated.
Denominators are small (up to 12 answerable and 6 non-answerable queries per mode); metric differences of one query move percentages by up to 8.3 percentage points.

Raw retrieval scores in traces are quantized to 12 decimal places so two process runs serialize byte-identically; BM25's last-ulp float variance from hash-randomized summation order never changes rankings.
Query wording is constrained to exact token forms present in the gold sentences because the committed extractive generator has no stemming.
